result.title: QuaNAS: Uncertainty-Aware Reuse of Earlier Searches for Query-Efficient Neural Architecture Search
result.comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 13 tables. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23562488
result.summary: Neural architecture search (NAS) on a new dataset often affords only tens of short training runs, so what the search knows before its first evaluation decides its efficiency. Yet most NAS methods start from scratch, guided at best by zero-cost proxies that are unreliable across tasks. QuaNAS treats a library of earlier searches in the same search space as explicit knowledge of uncertain reliability. Main effects of design decisions learned from this library and, secondarily, zero-cost proxies become priors over candidate architectures without any label of the new dataset. A Gaussian process starts at the prior optimum and re-estimates after every evaluation how far each prior is trusted. Under a protocol frozen before any confirmation data were seen, QuaNAS was evaluated once on 12 new image, time-series, text and tabular datasets. It lowered anytime regret on the short-training objective 2.7- to 3.9-fold relative to five pre-specified NAS baselines that start from scratch (Holm-adjusted p = 0.0012 each). Its final models matched (non-inferiority margin 0.5 pp) or exceeded matched-recipe reference models on nine datasets, as did the prior optimum, selected without a single evaluation. Post-hoc comparisons with established transfer methods given the same library trace the gain to the library: without it, the same Gaussian process had over twice the regret. They also show where each transfer mechanism works best: the pooled main effects of QuaNAS for weakly transferable tabular tasks, per-task surrogates for image, time-series and text tasks and for small or mismatched libraries. Finally, the main effects make the transferred knowledge inspectable.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 QuaNAS，将同一搜索空间内的既有 NAS 搜索库视为带不确定可靠性的先验，辅以零成本代理构建架构先验，并用高斯过程在每次评估后重新估计各先验的可信度，以在只有数十次训练评估时降低 anytime regret。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「复用历史搜索经验并按新证据逐步校准先验可信度」的做法，可能与 LVR 中复用先前推理轨迹、在有限评估预算下判断证据是否可信的问题有概念联系，可供核查。
